Caudal Epidural Injections

Epidural caudal injections are an effective, non-surgical procedure that helps in treating lower-back and leg pain originating from lower lumbo sacral spine. Dr Parag C Paradkar ORTHO CURE & PAIN RELIEV clinic provides cutting-edge caudal epidural injection treatment for considerable and protracted pain relief.

What is a Caudal Epidural?

Caudal epidural injection is a type of epidural injection that places Anti Inflammatory medicine (and anaesthetic agent into the epidural space at the very end of the spine, just above the coccyx. This is mainly used to treat pain that spreads to the buttocks and legs. The drug helps reduce nerve root pathology and nerve inflammation, thus eliminating pressure and offering immense pain relief. It is a safe and fast non-invasive procedure.

Why is a Caudal Epidural Necessary?

A caudal epidural represents a critical intervention for lower-back pain in cases where other techniques have already been shown to be ineffective. It is usually helpful in treating low backpain due to herniated disc-sciatica, herniated disc-coccydynia (tailbone pain), and Prolapsed disc. This direct injection to the inflammation source can provide long-term relief and increase mobility, preventing more invasive surgical procedures and risks.

Why should I select Dr Parag C Paradkar?

Dr Paradkar is an Internationally trained orthopedic doctor and a leading non-surgical expert in interventional pain management with nearly fifteen years of worldwide experience and a record of treating more than twenty-five thousand patients. His globally renowned methods incorporate sophisticated imaging methods, such as fluoroscopy (C arm) and ultrasound mapping, to guarantee point accuracy. This accuracy ensures that the effects of the surgical procedure are maximised and that the patient may resume normal life activities after a short time, which minimises the number of analgesic pills used.
